output:
function StepClimb(n: integer): integer;
begin
  if n = 1 then
    Result := 1
  else if n = 2 then
    Result := 2
  else if n = 3 then
    Result := 4
  else
    Result := StepClimb(n - 1) + StepClimb(n - 2) + StepClimb(n - 3);
end;
